instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_18_tabbed_plate.dxf from /home/user/Desktop using the GUI DXF import workflow (File > Import), then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the existing base plate, tab guides, and hole-location marks to create the final 180 x 80 base plate with three rectangular top tabs, each width 20 and height 12, with tab center X coordinates 35, 90, and 145. Add three diameter 8 holes inside the plate at (35,30), (90,30), and (145,30). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_18.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
